name: held-writer-pin-is-in-process-only
body: The held-writer freshness pin holds an in-process read-write `lbug::Database` beside the read-only freshness read; a cross-process writer's lock shape is not exercised by this test (the separate review-list e2e covers a cross-process read-only reader beside a held writer). Extend if lbug's file-lock semantics change or a cross-process writer scenario must be pinned.
